title: Cosmonaut drew an object that stopped beside their spacecraft
summary: Kevin Knuth tells of Cosmonaut drew an object that stopped beside their spacecraft, about unspecified at Earth orbit, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: fact, they had a spacecraft that stopped next to them halfway through their orbit. And the cosmonaut drew a picture of the object.

tellings.difference: Adds that photographs were taken and credits the source 'akan-atanv'.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Knuth's secondhand account of a cosmonaut who drew an object that stopped beside the spacecraft mid-orbit.

as_told.title: Cosmonaut sees windowed craft pacing their spacecraft
